Use case scientific-educational. Make a polished Korean GetPassLab technical learning infographic, landscape 1536x1024, white background, pale grey equipment, navy #25334B large crisp Korean labels, slate outlines, restrained blue numbered callouts. One complete EDUCATIONAL performance-test piping arrangement, no manufacturer. Accurate simplified technical schematic with recognizable realistic pump, physical valves and flow meter; no theatrical 3D, no extra decorative pipes. Title "성능시험 배관 · 유량 측정 상태".
EXACT topology mandatory: water tank at far left labelled "수조", one suction pipe leaves tank bottom to "펌프"; pump outlet travels right to a CLEAR T-junction solid dot. From junction the upper/main branch runs right through valve ① "설비측 토출밸브" marked "닫힘" and ends at right label "설비측". This closed main branch is neutral grey and has NO water-flow arrows beyond the closed valve. The test branch starts at the SAME T-junction BEFORE valve①, runs downward then horizontally right through in this exact order: valve② "시험배관 개폐밸브" marked "열림", then a visibly distinct flowmeter "유량계", then valve③ "유량조절밸브" marked "조절", then a return line routed at bottom of diagram all the way back into the original water tank. No crossed pipes or ambiguous joints, no extra connections. Green #15785C directional arrows along the actual flowing path tank→pump→T-junction→②→flowmeter→③→tank. Only one return path. Draw flowmeter without fabricated calibrated numbers; do not create performance curves, pressure gauges or flow values. The entire assembly must be readable and not cropped. Place large ①②③ blue numbered tags at their respective valves, text labels well separated from pipes. Bottom three short strips "① 설비측 차단", "② 시험배관 개방", "③ 유량 조절". Footer "학습용 재구성 · 흡입밸브·체크밸브·순환배관·압력계 생략". It is a simplified learning circuit, not an installation drawing. Every flow arrow must follow the connected pipe path and avoid the closed branch. Large labels, not dense paragraph cards.
